texte.Ein geschützter Raum, in dem du dich ver: A sheltered space where you feel understood, seen and held — and where you can be exactly who you are.
texte.Ich arbeite mit Menschen, die mehr wolle: I work with people who want more.
texte.Mehr Sinn, mehr inneres Gleichgewicht, m: More meaning, more inner balance, more connection with yourself. Not a particular gender, not a particular age, not a particular stage of life — what matters is that you can talk without explaining yourself and without being judged.
texte.Das ist die Rückmeldung, die ich am häuf: That’s what I hear most often: that with me people can let their guard down and say what’s really going on. Many come back — because they feel they’re getting closer to themselves.
texte.Wie das aussieht, wenn wir zusammenarbei: Here’s what working together actually looks like.
texte.Ein Raum, in dem du nicht funktionieren: A space where you don’t have to hold it together.
texte.Im Gespräch schauen wir gemeinsam auf da: When we talk, we look together at what’s really going on inside you. Not at what you tell other people when they ask how you are — but at what sits underneath.
texte.Du gewinnst Klarheit über deine Situatio: You gain clarity about your situation, about the patterns that keep repeating, and about your next steps — in your private life and at work. I hold a sheltered space where you can be honest — with me and with yourself. I won’t push you anywhere; you set the pace.

texte.Coaching und hnc ersetzen keine ärztlich: Coaching and hnc are not a substitute for medical or psychotherapeutic treatment, and they don’t diagnose.

texte.Die meisten wissen vor dem ersten Termin: Most people don’t quite know what to expect before the first appointment. So here’s how it works with me.
texte.Am Anfang steht ein kostenloses Erstgesp: It begins with a free first conversation, thirty minutes, by phone or online. You tell me what it’s about and we look together at what you need. From there we put a package together — usually several sessions spread over time, because a single appointment rarely shifts much. We decide together how many that will be.
texte.Wir sehen uns in meinen Räumen in Düssel: We meet at my practice in Düsseldorf, where you can arrive and settle without rushing — or online, if you prefer that or the journey would be too far. What you tell me stays between us. And between appointments I’m reachable, in case something surfaces that can’t wait until next time.
What this kind of work costs.
texte.Welches Paket zu dir passt, entscheiden: We decide together which package suits you, after that first conversation. So you know what you’re getting into, it’s all set out here.
texte.Nach einer erfolgreichen Karriere in der: After a successful career in business and co-founding several companies in real estate, I deliberately chose a different path — one that comes from the heart.
texte.Ich wollte meinen beruflichen Lebensinha: I didn’t want my working life to be defined by financial success alone. I wanted to contribute something that feels meaningful and worth doing. For me, that’s working with people.
texte.Diese Entscheidung war keine strategisch: That wasn’t a strategic decision — it came from the heart. Today I accompany people who long for real change, who have a clear goal in front of them and are ready to walk their path with new clarity, depth and confidence.
texte.Als zertifizierter Life &amp; Business C: As a certified life & business coach I bring together solid training and a fine ear for what sits between the lines. People often describe me as someone who helps emotions surface — someone who makes real feelings visible in a sheltered space, creates clarity and offers warm, steady support.
texte.Ich arbeite mit Menschen, die mehr wolle: I work with people who want more — more meaning, more inner balance, more connection with themselves. Whether it’s something private or your professional development: my coaching is a space where you feel understood, seen and held.
texte.Mit Herz, Feingefühl und einem Blick für: With heart, sensitivity and an eye for what matters, I’ll walk with you into your future.

For anyone who finally wants to take this side of their life into their own hands, I offer a separate format. I sell nothing and recommend no products. What I do is make sure you understand what you’re doing, and that you stick with it.

texte.Es ist ein Handwerk. Und Handwerk darf m: It’s a craft. And a craft can be learned — at any age, from any starting point.
I know both sides of money.
texte.Vor meiner Arbeit als Coach habe ich Pri: Before my work as a coach I advised private clients at a large German bank. I saw the questions people bring through the door — and how often they leave feeling they hadn’t understood something they had every right to understand.
texte.Seit über einem Jahrzehnt baue ich außer: For more than a decade I’ve also been helping build several real-estate companies. So I know not only how to talk about wealth, but what it feels like to build some: the doubt at the start, the long stretches with nothing visible to show, the decisions you make before you’re sure.
texte.Was mich nicht loslässt, ist eine Beobac: One thing I keep coming back to: plenty of people are clever, work hard and earn well — and still don’t know where their money actually goes. Not out of carelessness, but because nobody ever showed them they were allowed to look.
texte.Es gibt keinen Mindeststand, ab dem man: There’s no minimum balance you have to reach before you’re allowed to come. Some start with a bank statement they haven’t looked at for months. Others have had a portfolio for years and finally want to understand it rather than merely own it.
texte.Für alle, bei denen Geld ein diffuses Un: For anyone who finds money a vague source of unease. We look at it together: what comes in, what goes out, what stays. We build a cushion that lets you sleep at night, and clear up what has piled up. At the end you know your numbers — and that alone changes a surprising amount.
texte.Für alle, die anfangen wollen und nicht: For anyone who wants to start and doesn’t know where. We go through the basics: how does saving work once it’s more than a bank account? What do interest, time and risk actually mean? You build a structure that fits your life — and learn enough to decide for yourself instead of having to take someone’s word for it.
texte.Für alle, die schon etwas aufgebaut habe: For anyone who has already built something. We put in order what has grown, check whether it still matches your goals, and look at the bigger picture: retirement, children, working for yourself, property. Not in order to have more — but to know what it’s for.
texte.Ich bin keine Anlageberaterin und keine: I’m not an investment adviser and not a broker. I recommend no products, no funds, no insurance and no individual securities. I sell nothing and take commission from no one — which is why I can tell you openly when something doesn’t suit you.
texte.Ich mache auch keine Steuerberatung und: Nor do I give tax or legal advice. If that’s where your question belongs, I’ll say so and, where I can, point you to someone.
texte.Ich sorge dafür, dass du verstehst, was: I make sure you understand what you’re doing. That you know your numbers, can weigh up your options and stay with it, even when it gets tedious. The decisions are yours.
texte.Dreißig Minuten, kostenlos. Du erzählst,: Thirty minutes, free of charge. You tell me where you stand. I tell you which level suits you — and whether I’m the right person for you.
texte.Eine ausführliche Sitzung, in der wir al: A thorough session in which we put everything on the table. Afterwards you know where you stand — often for the first time in a long while.
texte.Wir arbeiten in Etappen, mit konkreten S: We work in stages, with concrete steps between appointments. How many there’ll be depends on what you have in mind.
